meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service

copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 它会把你写的 Python 代码(Flask、Django 或 FastAPI)发布到 Azure App Service 的 Linux 环境;缺资源组、计划或 Web 应用时会先建好,再按框架设好启动命令并完成部署。
howto.when: 当你说“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”“FastAPI App Service”等,或要求把 Python 部署到 App Service 时接管;容器应用、Functions、非 Python 项目不适用。

say.note: 自动创建资源组和计划并部署

say.text: 用 azd 部署这个 Django 项目到 App Service
say.note: 存在 azure.yaml 时走 azd 路径

say.text: 把 FastAPI 项目部署到 App Service Linux
say.note: 自动设置 uvicorn 启动命令

howto.what_en: It publishes your Python code (Flask, Django or FastAPI) to Azure App Service on Linux; if the resource group, plan or web app is missing it creates them, sets the startup command, then deploys.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "Flask App Service", "Django App Service" or "deploy Python to App Service"; not for Container Apps, Functions or non-Python projects.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Creates resource group and plan, then deploys

say_en.note: Uses the azd path if azure.yaml exists
